plan.title: Bronchial epithelium cytokine vs vehicle: pathway footprint activity
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question asks which signaling pathways show a transcriptional footprint of activity in cytokine-treated versus vehicle bronchial epithelial samples (6 vs 6, unpaired, single batch, raw Salmon gene counts), explicitly contrasting footprint-based inference against simple pathway-member expression. The plan follows the grounded procedure: QC first to characterize the flagged low-depth sample (sample_01, ~4x below median library size) without silently dropping it; DESeq2 Wald test with apeglm shrinkage for the differential expression backbone that every downstream footprint method consumes; then two complementary footprint-based activity analyses using decoupleR — mlm on the PROGENy signaling-pathway weight model (the direct answer to 'which signaling pathways are active by footprint, not by membership') and ulm on the CollecTRI TF regulons (upstream regulators driving the same footprint, since cytokine signaling acts through TFs like NF-kB/STAT/IRF). A parallel fgsea preranked GSEA on Hallmark/Reactome/WikiPathways gives a membership-based enrichment view explicitly to contrast against the footprint results, closing the loop the question asks about. All activity/enrichment steps rank on the DESeq2 Wald statistic from the full tested-gene list (never a thresholded list), per the grounded ranking-metric rule. A final report step integrates DE, pathway/TF footprint activity, enrichment, and the sample_01 QC caveat.

steps.method: vst(blind) PCA + sample distance heatmap + library size QC on sample_01
keep genes with >=10 counts in >=6 samples (smallest group size)
DESeq2 design ~condition, explicit reference level = control
apeglm shrinkage of the treated-vs-control coefficient
decoupleR mlm on PROGENy human footprint model, contrast Wald statistic of all tested genes
decoupleR ulm on CollecTRI human regulons, contrast Wald statistic of all tested genes
fgsea preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark human then Reactome and WikiPathways
integrated report: DE table, pathway/TF activity, enrichment, QC diagnostics, sample_01 caveat
